title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in…
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 contain an OS Command Injection vulnerability due to improper neutralization of special elements. This flaw allows a high-privileged attacker with remote access to execute arbitrary commands on the affected system. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 score of 7.2, indicating high severity. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided in the input data.
